explanations: The breaker trips when consecutiveFailures reaches the threshold, but recordSuccess() only switches the state back to CLOSED and never resets the counter. Failures therefore accumulate over the life of the process: three isolated errors spread across a day open the circuit, and after a successful half-open probe the counter is still at or above the threshold, so the next single failure re-opens it. Resetting the counter on success makes the failures genuinely consecutive again.
